scope: Fresh review of the rebuilt nine standard rows after accepted waving revision 02, failed revision 04 and maximum-right-edge row registration. Cardinal/look rows are outside this review.

method.limitation: The verdict covers still-frame readability, ordered-pose semantics and geometric continuity. Actual playback smoothness and runtime state transitions were not watched.

scale_and_baseline.assessment: The previously conspicuous large waving cat and small failed cat are resolved. At native size the three states read as the same-sized character with mild pose and fullness differences, without a material scale or landing-height discontinuity.

first_frame_bright_cat_proxy.method: Largest four-connected bright-neutral component, alpha >128, min RGB >145 and channel spread <75; a read-only corroborating proxy, not semantic segmentation.

scale_and_baseline.interpretation: Cat width differs by about 3% across these frame-00 proxies. Failed remains rounder with a higher awake-ear/head silhouette; this is visible but mild rather than the old smaller-body pop. Waving has similar body height and mass to idle.
nonblocking_position_notes: Waving cat sits approximately 14 px farther left than idle at the bright-component left boundary, leaving room for the lifted paw. This is a modest lateral pose/layout change, not scale or baseline pop.
Failed signal/pair right edge drifts about 5 px across the row while its vertical level remains stable. The prop remains on screen right and no material jump is visible in the ordered poses.

state_semantics.idle: Closed contented eyes and visible back/fullness changes retain breathing geometry with blue bottom light.
state_semantics.running-right: Right-facing whole-body gait with alternating reached/gathered legs; signal stays screen right and blue.
state_semantics.running-left: Left-facing whole-body gait with corresponding front reach and rear push; signal remains screen right rather than being scene-mirrored.
state_semantics.waving: Raised forepaw and pink pads remain clear after scale repair, with a resting return pose.
state_semantics.jumping: Ordered frames still show the entire pair rising, reaching an airborne apex and returning to its baseline; no apparent loss of the preserved jump offset.
state_semantics.failed: Flattened outward ears, sad brows, lowered chin and slight recovery remain clear after proportion repair. Red top lamp is correct.
state_semantics.waiting: Open attentive eyes, head tilt and lifted forepaw remain distinguishable from the slumped failed sequence despite sharing red.
state_semantics.running: Low focused eyelids and subtle forepaw/body changes accompany the green middle lamp.
state_semantics.review: Visible head/gaze turn distinguishes the ordered sequence from the more front/downward working row; both use green and some resting poses overlap.

identity_and_prop: Pure-white fluffy cat identity, natural dark eyes, pink nose/ears, wrapped tail and vintage charcoal three-lamp signal remain consistent. Red/green/blue lamp order and active state-family colors are correct. The right-side prop convention is preserved throughout.
remaining_nonblocking_work: Apply the already planned final cyan despill and recheck fur edges, signal rims, lenses and bounds.
